description:
Find work emails and phone numbers, validate contact information, generate email addresses, check employment status, and enrich B2B contact records directly through ChatGPT. eCore connects your conversations to DataCore's data capabilities, helping your team work with more reliable contact information without switching between tools.

What you can do:

Find Work Email Addresses: Retrieve available work email information for B2B contacts using the information you provide.
Validate email addresses: Check one or more email addresses and retrieve their validation status.
Verify employment: Check whether a contact still works at their company or has changed jobs.
Enrich contact records: Retrieve additional contact information through DataForge using supported enrichment options.
Find business phone numbers: Retrieve available business phone information for B2B contacts where supported by the available data and enrichment options.

Connect your eCore account to get started. Available operations depend on the information provided and the capabilities supported by each tool.

defaultPrompt: Enrich this lead {name} at {company}: return title, location, LinkedIn, verified email and phone.
Validate {email}: is it Valid, Invalid, or Unknown, and confirm current title and company.
Research {company}: company profile plus key decision-makers with titles and LinkedIn URLs.
